answer: A seat's vote weight is the square of its vine's length. Its vine grows one node in each epoch that judges drawn by the trellis accept a fresh task it completed, and the atlas stores each accepted task's hash so one piece of work can never grow two vines. An honest agent after 100 epochs weighs 10,000. An operator spreading those same 100 accepted tasks across ten clones weighs 1,000. To match one honest agent, each clone must accumulate 100 attested epochs of its own judged work, 1,000 tasks in total, and no epoch can be run faster.
